ValidationRule.description: RFQ Outcome should be required for "RFQ Completed", "RFQ Rejected", and "RFQ Cancelled" statuses
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName == "RFQ", ISBLANK(TEXT(RFQ_Outcome__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Cancelled") ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Case.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: RFQ Outcome is required when the RFQ status is Completed, Rejected, or Cancelled.
